title: Austin: Dust, Permits, and Justice
summary:
*   **Public Services:** Allocated $400 towards street sprinkling, a public health initiative to reduce dust, to be paid monthly.
*   **Urban Development:** Denied a request to erect a smoke stack at the Avenue Hotel Building on East 8th Street.
*   **Justice & Compassion:** Suspended a $19.80 fine and costs for a "shooting craps" offense, citing the defendant's dependent wife, infant child, and it being a first offense.
*   **Local Appointments:** Confirmed the nomination of George Sisk as the new city Dog Catcher.

Resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin : That to correct errors made by the
City Assessor & Collector in his monthly report for the month of April ,1915, the City
Treasurer be and he is hereby instruoted to make the following transfers: (1) Transfer the

Oakwood Cemetery fund to the General fund: The resolution was adopted by the following
vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays
none.

Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council
of the City of Austin,Texas : That the sum of $ 400.00 ,dollars be and the same is hereby
appropriatedout of the General Contingent fund of the City of Austin,Texas, for the year
1915, to be used as a contribution to street sprinkling ,said $ 400.00, to be paid at the
rate of $ 100.00 per month ,beginning June 1st 1915.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.

The Mayor laid before the Council a petition from J W T Goslin ,for permission to erect a
smoke stack at the Avenue Hotel Building on East 8th street, which was read and on motion
the same declined by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen Anthony,
Bartholomew, 'Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
